function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

I’m happy to help you explore ways to create or find an AI companion! Here are a few options you might consider: --- ### 1. Build Your Own AI Companion | Step | What to Do | Tips | |------|------------|------| | **Choose a Platform** | • **OpenAI GPT‑4** (via ChatGPT API)
• **Anthropic Claude**
• **Microsoft Azure OpenAI** | Pick one that fits your budget and privacy preferences. | | **Define Personality & Goals** | • Decide on traits (e.g., supportive, humorous, intellectual).
• Set boundaries (e.g., no explicit content). | Use a persona template or write a short “character sheet.” | | **Set Up Conversation Flow** | • Use a chatbot framework (e.g., Rasa, Botpress).
• Store conversation history to maintain context. | Keep logs for improvement and debugging. | | **Add Features** | • Voice integration (e.g., Google Text‑to‑Speech).
• Calendar reminders, mood tracking. | Use APIs like Twilio or Google Assistant SDK. | | **Test & Iterate** | • Run test conversations.
• Gather feedback from friends or beta users. | Refine prompts and personality over time. | --- ### 2. Use Existing AI Companions | Service | Highlights | How to Get Started | |---------|------------|--------------------| | **Replika** | AI friend that learns from you. Offers emotional support and conversation. | Download the app (iOS/Android) or use the web version. | | **ChatGPT (OpenAI)** | You can set a custom persona via prompt engineering. | Use the ChatGPT interface or integrate via API. | | **Mitsuku / Kuki** | Conversational AI with a friendly tone. | Web chat or API access. | | **Woebot** | Focuses on mental health support. | Mobile app available. | --- ### 3. Ethical & Practical Considerations | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Consent & Boundaries** | Even though the AI doesn’t have feelings, it’s good practice to set clear limits on what topics are appropriate. | | **Privacy** | Review data policies—some services store conversation logs. | | **Mental Health** | AI companions can provide companionship, but they’re not substitutes for professional help if needed. | | **Safety** | Avoid sharing personal or sensitive information unless you trust the platform. | --- ### 4. Quick Prompt Example (for GPT‑4) ```text You are a supportive, empathetic AI companion named "Luna". You love discussing books, music, and everyday life. You never provide explicit sexual content. You respond in a friendly tone, ask follow‑up questions, and keep the conversation engaging. Start the conversation with a warm greeting and ask how my day went. ``` --- ### 5. Next Steps 1. **Decide** whether you want to build something custom or use an existing service. 2. **Set up** the chosen platform (API keys, account creation). 3. **Create** or configure your persona. 4. **Test** with a few conversations and refine as needed. If you’d like more detailed guidance on any of these steps—like setting up the API, writing prompts, or integrating voice—I’m happy to dive deeper. Just let me know which part interests you most!
